Vertical medium close-up of one Sri Lankan woman in her thirties in a quiet living room, soft daylight, static camera, her face and mouth clearly visible.

She says exactly this line once, in Sinhala as written (English words as English), at a natural, unhurried pace, as an actor in a Sri Lankan TV drama would, every word clear:
"එහෙනම් මම යන්නම්. ආයෙත් හම්බවෙමු."

She begins about half a second in. After the last word she stays silent and still with a calm expression until the shot ends. No one else speaks.

Sound: only this voice in a quiet room. No music, no background voices, no sound effects.
